integrity_statement: The proof gives an explicit complete DFA and an all-parameter Myhill--Nerode lower bound. The standalone executable performs finite independent cross-checks, not a substitute for the proof. No independent external validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The classification covers standard-generator direct products of rank-two dihedral Coxeter systems, not higher-rank irreducible factors, arbitrary generating sets, nondeterministic automata, or partial input conventions. Historical priority remains subject to independent investigation.
title: Exact complete-DFA complexity for palindromic reduced words of dihedral Coxeter products
